answer: Every tower has a coverage boundary, and a genuine user crosses it at walking or driving speed, leaving a log of crossings that matches local roads, with a violet dusk of evening crossings spread across the day. The verifier replays those crossings against a map, and a pigment of fake data cannot paint a teleport, because a device cannot be in two cells at once. A reef of cloned accounts would all cross the same boundary at the same improbable moment, while real crossings spread out like fruit ripening at different times.
